measurement.source: Native Windows GetPerformanceInfo; pagefile configuration is not runtime capacity.

memory.policy_basis: Recent trainer used about6GB private memory at Windows-confirmed exhaustion. Default6GiB allowance plus3GiB operational reserve before model loading.
memory.scope: Pre-load Windows capacity check only. Free physical RAM cannot replace commit headroom. Not native BF16, smoke, benchmark, runtime stability or accuracy evidence. Later memory demand can change.

scope: Graceful memory-reserve stop; controller finalexit0. No additional training; resume remaining final original then pilot/candidate in same locked comparison. No final outcome used for model choice.
